mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to a hawkish Fed response and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but FEDFUNDS does not rise by > 25bp in the next 3 months, or SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by INDPRO, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation higher and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO drops by > 2% m-o-m but CPIAUCSL does not rise by > 0.5pp over the next 3 months, or SPX 60-day returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts series HOUST crosses above its 12-month moving average, it signals an improving housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST crosses above 12mo MA but SPX 20-day returns are negative > 40% of the time, or RSAFS does not rise by > 1% in the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 5% but GDPC1 growth does not slow by > 1pp over the next 6 months, or SPX 60-day returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate UNRATE and payroll employment PAYEMS both rise together over a 3-month period, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE and PAYEMS both rise over 3 months but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time, or CPIAUCSL does not drop by > 0.3pp in the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures RSAFS rise by more than 2% over the previous 6 months, it signals strong consumer demand that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS rises by > 2% in 6 months but SPX 20-day returns are negative > 40% of the time, or INDPRO does not rise by > 1% in the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in the consumer price index CPIAUCSL exceeds 3%, it signals high inflation that will erode consumer purchasing power and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3% but SPX 60-day returns are positive > 50% of the time, or FEDFUNDS does not rise by > 50bp in the next 6 months.
